issuer: the Road Transport Department Malaysia (Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan, JPJ), at its state offices and branches
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Road Transport Act 1987 (Act 333, as amended to 15 October 2023, the text on JPJ's portal): no one under 17 may drive a motor vehicle other than a motorcycle or an invalid carriage (s 39(2)); a probationary driving licence is one for a probationary period of two years given to someone who has passed the competency test (s 2), and a (competent) driving licence is granted only to someone who has held a probationary licence for two years (s 29(1)(a)), so a full licence is kept from 19 (17 plus the two probationary years; the Act's other route, a licence held in Malaysia or Singapore within three years, isn't held). JPJ's Driving License Transaction Fee Rate page gives the Competent Driver's License for class D at RM30.00 for citizens for a period of one year (RM60.00 for non-citizens); its CDL application page says the licence can be applied for a period of 1 to 5 years and gives the class D fee as RM30.00 for citizens. The one-year rate is held as charged for each year (perYear), with the non-citizen's RM60.00 (foreignFee) and the one-year term the table gives it; a holder may take one to five years, each at the rate. The probationary licence (RM60.00 for class D, two years) and the learner's licence aren't held. No identity card of JPJ's is held. Its foreign-licence conversion check runs as an online search and wasn't read, so no exchange list is held.

sources.title: Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987 (Akta 333), pindaan 15 Oktober 2023, JPJ portal
sources.said: “lesen memandu percubaan” ertinya lesen bagi suatu tempoh percubaan selama dua tahun yang diberikan kepada mana-mana orang yang telah lulus ujian kekompetenan yang ditetapkan; ... Sesuatu lesen memandu tidak boleh diberikan kepada mana-mana pemohon melainkan jika dia memuaskan hati Pengarah bahawa dia telah— (a) memegang lesen memandu percubaan selama tempoh dua tahun ... (2) Tiada seorang yang berumur kurang daripada tujuh belas tahun boleh memandu suatu kenderaan motor selain motosikal atau kenderaan orang cacat di jalan.
